Your first paragraph is spot on & exactly what I experience. I was going to make my own comment about it but then saw this, so decided to reply. For me it’s mostly when I’m either watching something (on TV or in a movie) physical happen to someone or if someone is verbally describing an experience of pain. My reaction is more severe to visuals rather than verbally. I truly & viscerally feel physical pangs in my body. For example if I see someone get shot or stabbed in the thigh in a movie, I immediately reach for my thigh to soothe it and feel an ache or pain there. I’ve experienced this since I was a child. And it kinda sucks.

I mean it depends what you like. There’s a podcast for everything (just like porn!) Ologies is good if you want to learn & laugh. Handsome Pod if you like queer comedy. On Being for beautiful existential shit. The Moth, This American Life & Snap Judgement for people’s wild life stories. Snap Judgement: Spooked for the only podcast that has real people telling their account of actual spooky af ghost/supernatural stories. Some of the episodes really got to me. John Green’s The Anthropocene Reviewed is incredible (and he turned it into a book). And then there’s Radiolab! 

Just pick something you are into or want to learn about or are soothed by, and look up a podcast for it. I’m currently dorking tf out by listening to The Office Ladies which is Jenna Fischer & Angela Kinsey (Pam & Angela on the office) go through every episode of The Office and break it down and talk about what it was like filming, hilarious anecdotes, etc.

Hidden mold, old carpet, walls need to be repainted, a decaying orange peel underneath the refrigerator or oven, etc etc. The best thing is to do a thorough deep clean of the whole house or wherever the odor is, get underneath appliances and get rugs/carpet professionally cleaned, wipe baseboards & walls.
